title: 第005章 修出第一缕灵气神秘空间资源翻倍第006章 炼气一层神魂强大
slug: 炼气家族我有一个造化空间
lines: 第005章修出第一缕灵气，神秘空间·资源翻倍！
大椿功，木属性炼气期功法，是修仙界流传最广、普及度最高的五本五行属性炼气期功法之一。
烂大街，不代表真的烂。
烂大街，证明它足够基础、足够好用、受众最广。
而且，即便烂大街，也只是在修仙界烂大街。
凡人世界中，大椿功依旧是可遇不可求的仙家功法，依旧需要灵根方可修行。
大长老李光耀说道：“大椿功，此功法修炼出来的大椿功法力，木属性极其精纯，充满生机，能让人延年益寿。”
“除了可以提升灵力境界外，还能增强体质、增加寿命、免疫毒药。”
“并且伴随修炼等级提升后，还能修出灵识，拥有灵识之后，可以灵识探物、御剑飞行、激活符纸、操纵阵法杀敌等等。”
李青元听得双眼放光，十分期待。
“还有一点，尤为重要～”
大长老抚须笑道：“修炼大椿功，对你成为灵植夫拥有极大好处。”
大长老说道：“咱们家族，产业不多。”
“开采矿石，太累人。”
“猎杀灵兽，太危险。”
“驯养灵兽，周期长。”
“播种灵米，收益低。”
“咱们李氏仙族，掌控修仙百艺的，唯有老夫与族长。”
李青元适时送上“崇拜”
小眼神，说道：“大长老爷爷真厉害。”
果然，大长老很是受用，颇为自傲道：“族长是一阶中品符师，而老夫是一阶灵植夫。”
他继续说道：“小青元，你是三灵根，是家族的未来。”
“你未来只需要安心修炼，尽快达到炼气后期。”
“所以，开采矿石、猎杀灵兽、耕种灵米这些产业，要么耗费时间、要么太危险，你不需要去做。”
“不过～”
大长老补充道：“不过，按照家族传统，每个仙苗修行三年后，都要从事家族产业，为家族做出贡献，以换取修炼资源。”
“为了不显得你特殊，被族人排挤，你可以跟随老夫学习培育灵植。”
李青元的灵根资质不能暴露，所以，特殊待遇只能暗中进行，一旦明面上进行，也惹得族人们对他不满。
不患寡、而患不均。
人性向来如此。
李青元当即说道：“多谢大长老爷爷栽培。”
“青元一定不让您老失望。”
大长老笑道：“来，咱们继续学习大椿功。”
一天时间，很快过去。
“大长老爷爷，我先回家了，明天再来找您。”
content_en:
Chapter 005: The first ray of spiritual energy is cultivated, the mysterious space and resources are doubled!
Dachun Gong, a wood-attribute Qi-refining period technique, is one of the five most widely circulated and most popular five-element Qi-refining period techniques in the world of immortality.
Just because the street is bad doesn't mean it's really bad.
Bad Street proves that it is basic enough, easy enough to use, and has the widest audience.
Moreover, even if it is a bad street, it is only a bad street in the world of immortality.
In the mortal world, Da Chun Kung Fu is still an immortal skill that can only be encountered and cannot be found, and it still requires spiritual roots to practice.
Grand Elder Lee Kuan Yew said: "Dachun Gong, the magical power of Dachun Gong cultivated by this method, has extremely pure wood properties, is full of vitality, and can make people live longer."
"In addition to improving the realm of spiritual power, it can also enhance physical fitness, increase lifespan, and become immune to poisons."
"And as your cultivation level increases, you can also develop spiritual consciousness. Once you have spiritual consciousness, you can detect objects with your spiritual consciousness, fly with a sword, activate talismans, control formations to kill enemies, etc."
Li Qingyuan's eyes lit up when he heard it, and he was looking forward to it.
“There’s one more thing that’s particularly important~”
The great elder stroked his beard and said with a smile: "Practicing the Great Chun Kung will be of great benefit to you in becoming a spiritual cultivator."
The great elder said: "Our family doesn't have much property."
"Mining ore is too tiring."
"Hunting spiritual beasts is too dangerous."
"Taming a spiritual beast takes a long time."
"Sowing spiritual rice, the return is low."
"In our Li Clan, the only ones who control the various arts of cultivating immortals are me and the clan leader."
Li Qingyuan sent "worship" at the right time
With a small look in his eyes, he said, "Grandpa, the great elder, is so awesome."
Sure enough, the great elder was very pleased with it and said proudly: "The patriarch is a first-level mid-level talisman master, and I am a first-level spiritual cultivator."
He continued: "Xiao Qingyuan, you are the three spiritual roots and the future of the family."
"In the future, you just need to practice with peace of mind and reach the late stage of Qi refining as soon as possible."
"So, industries such as mining ores, hunting spiritual beasts, and cultivating spiritual rice are either time-consuming or too dangerous, so you don't need to do them."
"But~"
The great elder added: "However, according to family tradition, after three years of cultivation, every immortal seedling must engage in the family industry and contribute to the family in exchange for cultivation resources."
"In order not to appear special and be excluded by the tribe, you can learn to cultivate spiritual plants from me."
Li Qingyuan's spiritual root qualifications cannot be exposed, so special treatment can only be given secretly. Once it is done openly, it will also make the tribesmen dissatisfied with him.
Don’t worry about scarcity, but worry about inequality.
Human nature has always been like this.
Li Qingyuan said immediately: "Thank you, Grand Elder, for your cultivation."
"Qingyuan will never disappoint you."
"Okay."
The great elder smiled and said: "Come, let's continue learning the Great Chun Kung Fu."
One day passed quickly.
"Great Elder Grandpa, I'm going home first, and I'll come see you tomorrow."
